concerns.text: Task T016 bundles multiple distinct responsibilities (composite score calculation, warning emission, per‑repo aggregation, Wilcoxon test, and report generation). This makes the task overly coarse for a single implementation step and may hinder deterministic execution. Consider splitting into separate tasks (e.g., T016a compute composite score, T016b run Wilcoxon on per‑repo aggregates, T016c generate final report).
